Our Story

Reliable work, honest prices, done right the first time.

Girum Home Modeling was founded with a simple goal: to provide homeowners with reliable, high-quality remodeling services at fair and honest prices.

With over 15 years of combined experience in residential construction and renovation, our skilled team delivers craftsmanship you can trust. We approach every project with attention to detail, clear communication, and a commitment to getting the job done right.

We treat every home as if it were our own — respecting your time, your space, and your budget. Our bilingual team speaks English, Spanish, and Amharic, making the whole process easy and stress-free.

Licensed & Insured

Fully licensed and insured for your peace of mind.

Customer First

Frequently asked questions.

Absolutely. Girum Home Modeling is fully licensed and insured, so you're completely protected on every project from start to finish.

Yes. We handle the permitting and inspection process for basement finishing and other major remodels, so you don't have to navigate the paperwork on your own.

Both. We can source and manage all materials and labor as a complete turnkey project, or work labor-only with materials you provide — whichever fits your budget and preferences.

Yes — we offer free, no-obligation consultations and estimates. Reach out through our appointment form or give us a call and we'll set up a visit.

Most kitchen remodels take roughly three to six weeks depending on the scope of work and material availability. We provide a clear timeline before we begin so you always know what to expect.

We're happy to discuss flexible payment options to help your project fit your budget. Contact us and we'll walk you through what's available.
